description:
Deliver coalesced model-visible parent packets on orchestrated child lifecycle events.

## Background

UI toasts are not enough. The parent model must see: what changed, who is still running (orchestrated only), and the per-child nudge. Native overbuilt effect keys and exactly-once delivery. Pi `sendMessage` returns void. V1: one in-process submit per coalesced packet, consume once, no retry/ack claim.

`/bw run` is NOT this. `/bw run` injects a prompt. Idle continuation here is how the epic continues **after children settle**.

## Delivery

`pi.sendMessage({ customType, content, display: true, details }, { triggerTurn: true, deliverAs: "followUp" })`

- Never `steer` parent packets.
- Coalesce including idle: fold events arriving before submit so four near-simultaneous settlements are one turn, not four. Queue drain / "submit when no further pending" is fine; not a user-visible timer product.
- Delimit runtime nudge text from untrusted child output.
- Bound output; full transcript via show_minion.
- Parent-waking events: settled, aborted, failed. parentMessage is added in the messaging phase; leave a kind in the union so that issue can emit it.

## Success criteria

- Busy parent: events fold, one packet after the turn.
- Idle parent: several events still one packet/one turn.
- Mixed task types: each changed child has its own nudge.
- Spawn completions do not emit these packets.
- Consumed packet does not fire twice.

## Test plan

- Unit: coalesce ordering, per-child nudges, fleet snapshot filter.
- Integration: followUp not steer; idle multi-complete.

## Considerations

Packets accumulate in parent session history. Keep them small. Cost of parent-LLM-in-the-loop is real; coalescing is a cost feature.
title: Deliver coalesced parent lifecycle packets at a safe boundary
